mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a weak labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to adopt an accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 70% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers market anticipation of Federal Reserve policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY), the market prices in an imminent Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher discount rates depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which may lead to Federal Reserve policy easing and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in 60% of instances when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1800) signal a robust housing market and broader economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates continued growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in 70% of instances when HOUST > 1800.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) signals a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy, which triggers market anticipation of a recovery and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% YoY), the market prices in an imminent economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors reduce equity exposure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% YoY.
